author: Thunderus_22
body:
Hi I am Thunderus_22, the younger brother of xXEnderHD

I got banned on the 3rd of September 2015 for hacking and I'm really sorry I promise I've changed my ways and I'll never touch a hacked client ever again. I did deserve to get banned so it is a legit ban I got. If you unban me I promise to be a good member of the server Avicus and always listen to staff and follow the rules. Thanks for reading! 
Thunderus_22

title: Thunderus_22 Ban Appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Thunderus_22,

You have to wait a little bit longer before you can be appealed. Try to make another appeal within the next 4-6 months. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
